objective: Complete KnoTrail Application Cleanup: Remove all fabricated/dummy data across the entire application and rewrite Landing Page and Dashboard content in simple, professional English
acceptance_criteria: Complete dummy data removal: No fictional stakeholders (Elena Rostova, Marcus Vance, Sophia Chen, David Miller), fake commits/hashes, fake repository records, fake Slack/Jira/Linear/Notion/PagerDuty connected statuses, hardcoded decisions/tasks/risks/dependencies, or fake timelines in production runtime
Application-wide invariant: Only information originating from actual user-provided sources or genuinely generated and validated AI results may appear as project findings
New workspaces start clean with 0 findings and 0 sources; honest empty states shown across all views (Dashboard, Workspace, Sources, Analysis, Evidence, Review, Handover)
Source Manager cleanup: Only real operational file ingestions (PDF, TXT, Markdown) shown as connected; unimplemented services marked as Coming Soon or moved to Upcoming Connectors

Dashboard content simplified: Rewritten in simple, professional English without jargon (Project Overview, Recent Activity, Important Decisions, Pending Tasks, Identified Risks, Connected Sources); metrics computed from real stored records

Landing Page content simplified: Hero heading 'Keep Your Project Knowledge Even When People Leave', hero description 'KnoTrail helps teams collect project information, find important decisions and pending work, and prepare clear handovers with links to the original sources', buttons 'Add Project Documents' & 'How It Works', 3 simple workflow steps, zero fake terminal/stream or fake metrics
Zero-Auth & Incognito Invariant preserved: 100% accessible in private/incognito windows without login/signup
Tests use isolated synthetic fixtures inside test files only and do not depend on dummy records in the actual app
All automated tests pass (npm test) and production build succeeds (npm run build) with zero errors
non_goals: Do not alter Google Stitch design tokens or warm sage visual styling
Do not break Phase A handover approval gates, Phase B persistence, Phase C document ingestion, or Phase D Gemini extraction
Do not add login or signup

verification.result: 46 of 46 automated tests pass across Phase A (Handover Integrity & Gating), Phase B (Persistence & Workspace Isolation with isolated fixtures), Phase C (Real Document Ingestion & Extraction), and Phase D (Real AI Knowledge Extraction & Evidence Grounding with Google Gemini). Production build compiles cleanly with zero errors across all 13 API endpoints and 6 static pages.
